idea-plugin.name: Run Config Drift Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Run Config Drift Detector

"It works on my machine" often starts with a drifted run configuration. Run Config Drift Detector compares your IDE run configurations against a .run-requirements.yaml manifest, catching JDK mismatches, missing environment variables, and incorrect working directories before they cause mysterious failures.

Key Features

  • Health Report Dashboard — Per-configuration drift score with detailed findings
  • Requirements Manifest — Define expected settings in .run-requirements.yaml
  • JDK Validation — Verifies JDK version and vendor match project requirements
  • Environment Variable Checks — Ensures required env vars are present with correct values
  • Working Directory Validation — Confirms paths resolve correctly
  • Quick Fixes — One-click corrections for detected drift

Why Run Config Drift Detector?

Run configuration drift is a hidden source of "works on my machine" bugs. This plugin makes configurations declarative and verifiable, especially valuable for onboarding new team members.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Full drift detection, health reports, requirements manifest, quick fixes
  • Pro: Team config synchronization, drift notifications, CI/CD manifest validation, configuration history tracking, and multi-module project support
